DOG LOVERS...  This is the page for you!

Whether you are a casual dog lover, a seasoned trainer or somewhere in between, my YouTube channel has something for you! This is the best place to find my newest dog training videos, podcasts and more.    

I’ve worked with, trained and evaluated 1000's of dogs.  I have titled and trained obedience & protection dogs as well as pet dogs through my private dog training practice.

Through Bound Angels I instruct animal shelters, SPCA's and humane societies nationwide on canine behavior theory, behavior assessment, dog playgroups and more.   This instruction and knowledge of canine behavior and my rehabilitation techniques have saved countless thousands of dogs from shelters nationwide often giving them their only chance at adoption. 

I want you to have a happy and balanced relationship with your dog.   Let me help you!

My videos are  for all dogs, breeds;  puppies and adults.  

New content constantly added!
